cells.gaps: No source found says the financial, tax or payroll system went live on a new or upgraded system since October 2023. Smart Invoice, mandatory since July 2024, is an invoicing system and not the tax system itself.
cells.note: The IFMIS (2024), TaxOnline (2025) and the PMEC payroll (2026) are each in use by sources from 2023 or later. Nothing found says one of them went live on a new or upgraded system in the last three years, which stage 4 needs.
